Title: Service Map feature of Azure Monitor is now available in additional regions

Body.Content:
The Service Map feature of Azure Monitor is now available in Japan East, North Europe, and East US2. 

Service Map automatically discovers application components on Windows and Linux systems and maps communication between services. The feature enables you to view your servers, processes, inbound and outbound connection latency, and ports as interconnected systems. The only configuration required is installing an agent.

Learn more about Service Map >
